title: Weakly LUR norms and the Schur property
summary: A separable real or complex Banach space fails the Schur property if and only if it admits an equivalent Gâteaux smooth, weakly locally uniformly rotund norm which is not midpoint locally uniformly rotund. The construction enlarges an LUR unit ball by a weakly compact set and adds a weighted Hilbert-space term. The resulting norms can be chosen arbitrarily close to any prescribed equivalent LUR norm, and are Gâteaux smooth whenever the prescribed norm is Gâteaux smooth; Fréchet smoothness is preserved as well.
